description: Propeller + drivetrain installation data per propeller type (card M1-03, P Part 4 Step 1.3b). An engine uses CONSTANT_SPEED when configs/engines/<id>.json propeller_governor is true, else FIXED_PITCH. Everything here is installation data, not engine data. cp_scale is NOT configured: it is calibrated at start-up so the propeller absorbs the engine's take-off power at its rated propeller speed (CALIBRATED).

diameter_m.ref: typical 68 in propeller on Rotax 912/914/915 class installations

j_zero_thrust.ref: advance ratio where Cp reaches zero; generic fixed-pitch curve (JSBSim FGPropeller form)

rotating_inertia_kg_m2.ref: crank + gearbox + propeller reflected to the crankshaft

design_tas_kt.ref: MALE UAV cruise speed used for the calibration point

diameter_m.ref: typical 3-blade constant-speed propeller on AE300 class installations

j_zero_thrust.ref: generic constant-speed curve at reference pitch

rotating_inertia_kg_m2.ref: crank + gearbox + propeller reflected to the crankshaft

design_tas_kt.ref: MALE UAV cruise speed used for the calibration point

pitch_reference.ref: pitch (0..1) that absorbs take-off power at rated rpm, leaving governor authority both ways

governor_kp.ref: tuned for T-PHY-9 (settle < 2 s, overshoot < 3 %), tests/sim/test_rotor.py

governor_ki.ref: tuned for T-PHY-9 (settle < 2 s, overshoot < 3 %), tests/sim/test_rotor.py
